title: docs(spec): TOP_LEVEL_COLLECTIONS_NEVER_RESIDUAL names the readers of top-level datasets the tree has
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8NmLWYcxwHxEWCS68XFHnin)_
Fixes #29335

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改 `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` 里 `TOP_LEVEL_COLLECTIONS_NEVER_RESIDUAL` 的注释，外加一个 patch changeset。
- 为什么改：注释说顶层 `datasets` 由 `AppPlugin` 直接从 bundle 读取，树上没有这个读者；包体的 `datasets` 实际由引擎 `registerApp` 的 `METADATA_ARRAY_KEYS` 循环读取。
- 风险与回滚：零运行时风险，没有代码、类型或导出变化；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` 的那段注释（约 360 行）。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -n "No boot reader takes a top-level" packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`，预期命中 1 行。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- The `TOP_LEVEL_COLLECTIONS_NEVER_RESIDUAL` docblock now names the readers the tree has. Seed `data` and `jobs` are read off the stack whole, top level merged with every body (`resolveArtifactCollections`, `@objectstack/runtime`): `AppPlugin` hands the seed `data` to the seed loader and schedules the `jobs`. `datasets` are read off the package bodies only, by the engine's `registerApp` (`METADATA_ARRAY_KEYS`, `@objectstack/objectql`), and no boot reader takes a top-level `datasets` item that no body declares.
- The constant, the rule it encodes and every caller are unchanged.
- `.changeset/29335-residual-datasets-docblock.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch. The package ships `src/**/*.zod.ts` as source (`files[]`), so the comment publishes even though `dist/` carries none of it (measured: the new sentence has 0 hits in `dist/`; the constant's name, the positive control, has hits in `dist/`).

Readers measured on the tree at `94d3e254` (the branch's base before the merge of `origin/main`):

- `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts`: no read of `datasets` off the bundle or its collections. Each `datasets` word there is the seed `data` collector (`seedDatasets`, `readSeedDatasets`, `mergeSeedDatasets`).
- `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`: `METADATA_ARRAY_KEYS` lists `datasets`; `registerApp` runs `packageBodyCollectionRefusal` and then `registerMetadataCollections` over the body's keys.
- `packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts`: `ARTIFACT_FIELD_TO_TYPE` has no `datasets` row, so `unclaimedTopLevel` never lists one.

## Tests

- No test changed: the diff is a comment. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/owner-stamp-residual-build-boot.test.ts` (the test that pins the constant equal to the boot's rule): 1 file, 27 tests passed, at head `061f69c58`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0, at head `061f69c58`.

## Acceptance notes

- The boot-side half of the card (a `packages[]` stack's top-level `datasets` item that no body declares) is not fixed here, per triage's scope. It was measured on a kernel boot and is handed to the spec seat to file as a `domain:server` card: the item is dropped with no refusal and no warning.
- The same wrong attribution sits in a gate waiver: `scripts/check-stack-collection-maps.mjs`, the `ARTIFACT_FIELD_TO_TYPE` row for `datasets`, `jobs`, `datasources` and `translations`, says all four are consumed functionally by AppPlugin straight off the bundle. For `datasets` that is not so. Outside this card's file surface; reported to the seat, not edited.

## Verification

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on this diff derived 74 families at `061f69c5`. All 74 were run; 73 exit 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs every workspace package built), so it is NOT MEASURED locally and left to CI. `--ran` reconciliation: "74 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 73 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)".

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (No formatter ran. `pnpm lint` is the repo-wide scan CI owns; not run locally.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
